A valid family income certificate from the competent state authority (issued on or after 1 April of the admission year) has to be produced every year; an EWS certificate
scholarships.benefit: Family income under Rs 1 lakh a year: the entire tuition fee of Rs 62,500 per semester is remitted. scholarships.name: Tuition Fee Exemption for SC / ST / PwD students
scholarships.eligibility: B.Tech students admitted in the SC or ST categories, and all students with a benchmark disability (PwD), from the 2026 admission batch.
scholarships.benefit: No tuition fee is charged in any of the eight semesters. Only the annual fee and one-time fees are payable: Rs 63,050 in the first semester (of which Rs 9,100 is refundable deposits), then Rs 30,450, Rs 33,450 and Rs 36,800 at the start of the second, third and fourth years.

scholarships.name: RECT'78 Alumni Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Indian citizens in the second year of B.Tech (not admitted through DASA or as foreign nationals) who cleared every first-year course in the first attempt and are not already drawing another scholarship (a fee concession alone does not disqualify). Preference goes to students from rural areas
scholarships.benefit: About Rs 45,000 per scholar per year (subject to the endowment's interest income), paid through the second, third and fourth years as long as the student keeps clearing all courses without arrears and the head of department endorses the renewal.

scholarships.name: RECT'78 EWS Alumni Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Economically disadvantaged B.Tech students, identified in the second year (third semester). Two students were selected for 2026-27; earlier beneficiaries continue to be supported until they graduate.
scholarships.benefit: Tuition fee support funded by the 1978 batch endowment, continuing from the second year until graduation.

scholarships.name: RECT'89 Student Aid Fund
scholarships.eligibility: Economically deserving B.Tech students picked on a merit-cum-means basis from the second year onward, under an MoU between the 1989 batch's governing council and the institute. Six beneficiaries across the second, third and fourth years were named for 2026-27, plus two additional second-year women
scholarships.benefit: Comprehensive support that covers tuition, one-time institute fees and hostel and mess charges from the second year until the programme is completed.

scholarships.name: RECAL Scholarships (NIT Trichy Alumni Association)
scholarships.eligibility: NIT Trichy students of any branch or gender who meet the criteria of a given RECAL scheme: strong academic records for the merit scholarships, demonstrated financial need for the means scholarships. Applications are made on the scholarship portal in the October-November window and shortlisted
scholarships.benefit: Alumni-funded support for tuition and academic expenses plus a certificate signed by institute officials and RECAL office bearers. For 2025-26 RECAL announced 134 awardees sharing Rs 49.45 lakh; the institute's own count shows 211 RECAL scholarship recipients in 2023-24.

scholarships.name: Central and State Scholarships via the National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
scholarships.eligibility: Students who qualify for any central or state scheme hosted on NSP, including the Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students, Top Class Education for SC students, PM YASASVI for OBC/EBC/DNT students, scholarships for students with disabilities, PMSSS and the Prime
scholarships.benefit: Scheme-specific cash support paid by the sponsoring ministry or state; the institute verifies applications and issues the bonafide certificate, and a scholarship once granted runs until the course ends. NSP scholarships were the largest single channel on campus, with 397 recipients in 2024-25.

scholarships.name: National Fellowship and Scholarship for Higher Education of ST Students (Top Class Education)
scholarships.eligibility: Scheduled Tribe students admitted to a notified institute and course (NIT Trichy hosts the guidelines) whose total family income from all sources does not exceed Rs 6 lakh a year. Students taking this award cannot draw any other central or state scholarship for the same study.
scholarships.benefit: A Central Sector scheme of the Ministry of Tribal Affairs that funds the approved course costs in full, continuing for the whole course duration as long as the institute certifies satisfactory performance.

scholarships.name: Engineers India Limited (EIL) Scholarship for SC/ST students
scholarships.eligibility: SC and ST students in the first year of a full-time B.Tech in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Computer Science, Industrial, Chemical or Instrumentation engineering, who apply through the institute's scholarship section with caste and income certificates.
scholarships.benefit: A scholarship of Rs 3,000 paid by EIL through each of the four years of the degree, subject to the conditions in EIL's scheme.

scholarships.name: PM-Vidyalaxmi Education Loan Scheme
scholarships.eligibility: Students admitted to NIT Trichy who need an education loan; the scheme is a Government of India single-window portal for loans and linked interest support, and the institute's fee section points applicants to the official guidelines.
scholarships.benefit: Access to education loans from participating banks through one portal, with interest subsidy as laid down in the scheme guidelines; loan payments can be routed to the institute via the NEFT challan generated on the Samarth fee portal.
